tools.name: open_chat
tools.description: Open the UnoRouter chat interface to try any supported AI model through a single UI.

tools.name: open_docs
tools.description: Open a UnoRouter integration guide. Accepts a guide slug such as claude-code, codex, gemini-cli, openclaw, cc-switch, sillytavern, janitor-ai, risuai, or chub.

guide.description: Integration guide slug. Omit to open the documentation index.

tools.name: open_model
tools.description: Open the detail page for a specific model. Accepts a model slug such as claude-opus-4-7, gpt-5, gemini-2.5-pro, or flux.1-dev.

slug.description: Model slug as shown in the catalog (e.g. claude-opus-4-7).

tools.name: open_models_catalog
tools.description: Open the UnoRouter model catalog page, which lists every available model with live pricing across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, and other providers.

tools.name: open_pricing
tools.description: Open the UnoRouter pricing page to review subscription plans and pay-as-you-go rates.
